decisions.reason: White-label test pressings are inherently limited, collector-driven runs with low inventory risk. With no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, the firm has little reason for problemistic search, though such series often lapse naturally once stock sells out.

A German new wave compilation series fits closely with the firm's in-house label and its catalog of roots and classic popular music. Carrying it costs little in slack, and early results give no signal of underperformance, so the satisficing choice is to keep it.
